title: DOW-UAP-PR074, "[CALLSIGN] (Mission)HD_20220613"
what_is_it: Infrared sensor video recorded from a U.S. military platform, released as part of the PURSUE collection in response to a congressional request for UAP-related records.
interpretation_warnings: No body text was extractable from the source document — all facts derive from the CSV metadata description provided by war.gov.
The callsign in the video title is redacted, preventing identification of the specific mission or platform.
AARO uses the word 'likely' when attributing the video to an infrared sensor on a military platform, indicating this is an assessment, not a confirmed fact.
The materials lack a substantiated chain-of-custody, meaning the provenance and handling history of this video cannot be fully verified.
The video description in the metadata is truncated and incomplete beyond timestamp 00:14.
The object observed is described only as an 'area of contrast' — no determination of what it is has been provided.
